column1: # fleet/loops.tsv: the supervised loops table (name, where, command, user, description).
#   name         the unit name: com.nova.loop.<name>.plist on Darwin, nova-loop-<name>.service on Linux.
#   where        `every-bench` runs on all benches; `coordinator` runs on the coordination bench only.
#   command      the command line to run under nova-loop:
#                  $HOST              the host's machine name (from nova-config machine self)
#                  $WIDTH             the member width (from nova-config machine width <self>)
#                  $HARNESS           the harness binary path (from worker description)
#   user         the user account (`-` for every-bench rows).
#   description  what this loop does and what dies when it dies.

column5: Rowan's RECEIVE THREAD (Glenn 2026-09-22 5:12 PM, the XDP fast path)

Every 60 s writes the data volume's free GiB to host:<host>:disk_free_g (EX 180) and ~/nova-bench/run/disk-guard.state; under FLOOR_G (200) disk-guard --check refuses writers (exit 3), under STOP_G (100) it boots out every other com.nova.loop.* unit
Fetches this bench's own ~/nova-bench/mirror/*.git from GitHub every 60 s
The nova-sprint reconciler (nova-tools #3043): holds lease:reconciler and runs one pass a second as the coordinator ACL user
This bench's nova-sprint presence (nova-tools #3043): writes bench:<bench>:beat and bench:<bench>:owner (5 s TTL) once a second as the ns-bench seat

column3: $HOME/.local/bin/nova-secrets exec --store $HOME/nova-bench/secrets --as $COORDINATOR_SEAT --key $HOME/.config/nova-secrets/$COORDINATOR_SEAT.key --sops $SOPS --only NOVA_REDIS_COORDINATOR_PASSWORD --require NOVA_REDIS_COORDINATOR_PASSWORD -- /usr/bin/env NOVA_SPRINT_REDIS_USER=coordinator NOVA_SPRINT_REDIS_PASSWORD_ENV=NOVA_REDIS_COORDINATOR_PASSWORD $HOME/.local/bin/nova-sprint table --layout live --loop 1 --redis $STORE --out $HOME/rowan-working/tmp/session-0919b/TABLE.txt
